Official rules

The First Annual Haven Showcase

StepHaven's yearly show of the finest havens. Apply for a place, build your best town, and the winner is kept in the Hall of Winners for good.

Who runs it

The Haven Showcase is run by Brody R., the independent developer of StepHaven, in the United States ("we" in these rules).

Apple is not a sponsor of the Haven Showcase and is not involved in it in any way. Questions go to us, not to Apple.

Who can apply

Anyone of any age who plays StepHaven on an iPhone, has finished the tutorial and has played on at least two different days. Players under 18, or under the age of majority where they live, need a parent's or guardian's permission to apply.

The showcase is open worldwide, except where a contest like it isn't allowed.

Applying

Apply from the invitation in your StepHaven mailbox before applications close. You tell us whether you're building alone or with friends, and in a sentence or two what makes your haven special. Then you agree to the pledge and seal your application.

Places are limited. We read every application and choose keepers by their answer and by whether they're building in good faith. We don't have to give reasons for a choice. Accepted keepers receive a Showcase Pass by letter in the days after applications close.

Sending in a haven

  • Attach your pass to any haven of yours, solo or shared, and send it in before entries close. You can move the pass to another haven until you send it.
  • A shared haven may have up to four builders. Only the keeper holding the pass sends it in, and you name who built it.
  • When you send it, we keep a copy of the haven exactly as it is at that moment. That copy is your entry. Building afterwards doesn't change it.
  • One entry per pass. The haven must be your own work and your friends'.

Judging

Entries are judged by the StepHaven team, equally on four things. There is no public voting.

LayoutHow the town fits together: streets, spaces, flow.
StoryA haven that feels like a real place with a life of its own.
LivelinessGardens, light, water, the small things that make it busy.
DetailCare in the corners, close up.

Which items a haven uses doesn't matter: owning packs or StepHaven+ earns nothing. We choose one winner and a small number of finalists. Our decisions are final.

What's on offer

Every accepted keeper
A Showcase Pass
Every haven sent in
The pass, stamped Entered, to keep
The finalists
A place in the Hall of Winners beside the winner
The winner
A place in the Hall of Winners and an exclusive in-game keepsake

Everything on offer is inside StepHaven. None of it is steps, money or anything with a cash value, and none of it can be exchanged or transferred. In a shared haven, every builder named on the entry receives the same.

What we may show

By sending in a haven you agree we may show the entry: a copy of the haven others can visit, its picture, the name it's credited under, its flag and the words you wrote. We may show it in StepHaven, on stephaven.app and on StepHaven's social accounts, for as long as the Hall of Winners lasts. Your haven and everything you built stay yours.

Disqualification

We may remove an application or entry, or take back a pass, if:

  • it breaks the community rules, in the haven, its name or its words;
  • it's someone else's work, or copied from another player;
  • it uses more than one account, or anything that gets around the game's rules;
  • anyone involved is abusive to other players or to us.

Your information

An application sends us your player name, your answer, whether you're building with friends, and your iCloud account's anonymous ID so we can reply by letter. An entry adds the copy of your haven and what you wrote when you sent it in. Only we can read applications. Entries are shown to other players only if they're chosen as the winner or a finalist. Step counts and health data are never part of it. The privacy policy covers the rest.

Changes

If something outside our control stops the showcase from running fairly, we may change its dates or cancel it, and will say so in the app and on this page.
